prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Midwest US (Illinois, Ohio, Michigan)?
response_text:
When seeking reputable residential pest control companies in the Midwest, particularly in Illinois, Ohio, and Michigan, consider the following providers:

**Rose Pest Solutions**  
Established in 1860, Rose Pest Solutions is the nation's oldest pest control company. They offer comprehensive residential services across Michigan, Ohio, and Indiana, addressing pests such as ants, bed bugs, cockroaches, mosquitoes, rodents, stinging insects, termites, and wildlife. With 16 local offices, they ensure prompt and personalized service. Their technicians are licensed, insured, and undergo rigorous training. Rose Pest Solutions has received an average rating of 4.8 out of 5 stars from 7,998 reviews. ([rosepestsolutions.com](https://www.rosepestsolutions.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Smithereen Pest Management Services**  
Serving Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Michigan, Missouri, Tennessee, and Wisconsin, Smithereen offers integrated pest management solutions for both residential and commercial clients. Their services cover a wide range of pests, including wasps, ants, rodents, mosquitoes, wildlife, cockroaches, spiders, and termites. Smithereen was the first Green Shield Certified pest management company in Illinois, emphasizing environmentally responsible practices. ([smithereen.com](https://www.smithereen.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Franklin Pest Solutions**  
With a history dating back to 1929, Franklin Pest Solutions provides pest control services in Illinois and Indiana. They offer year-round protection plans for residential clients, targeting pests like termites, rodents, ants, cockroaches, and stinging insects. Their approach focuses on environmentally friendly methods and personalized solutions. ([franklin.us](https://franklin.us/?utm_source=openai))

**Delving Pest Control**  
Operating in Northern Ohio and Southeastern Michigan for over 25 years, Delving Pest Control offers discreet one-time treatments and ongoing plans without contracts. They handle pests such as ants, spiders, bed bugs, bees, and rodents. Their services are tailored for both residential and commercial clients, ensuring a pest-free environment year-round. ([delvingpest.com](https://www.delvingpest.com/pest-control-services/?utm_source=openai))

**Bowers Pest Control**  
With over 35 years of experience, Bowers Pest Control serves the Dayton, Ohio area and communities around Battle Creek and Kalamazoo, Michigan. They provide pest, insect, rodent, and nuisance-wildlife services, emphasizing thorough inspections and lasting solutions. Their services include bed bug treatments, termite inspections, and wildlife control. ([bowerspestcontrol.com](https://bowerspestcontrol.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Abell Pest Control**  
Abell offers pest control services across Michigan, including Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Detroit, Flint, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Novi, Sterling Heights, Traverse City, and Waterford. They provide year-round protection for both residential and commercial properties, addressing pests like ants, rodents, termites, and wildlife. Their licensed technicians are committed to delivering fast and effective solutions. ([abellpestcontrol.com](https://www.abellpestcontrol.com/en-us/locations/michigan?utm_source=openai))

When selecting a pest control provider, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, customer reviews, and commitment to environmentally responsible practices. It's advisable to contact these companies directly to discuss your specific needs and ensure they offer services in your exact location.
